en.headline: HKMA signs pact to link regional trade data
en.dek: A pilot linking Hong Kong's commercial data platform with a Shanghai digital-trade system has produced 10 loan approvals worth HK$180 million, the authority said.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Monday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with the Pan-Asian Alliance for Digital Trade to connect freight, logistics and trade data and to support digital trade finance.

The alliance groups single-window operators and e-commerce service providers, and its members cover 15 economies, including ASEAN members, the authority said. The pact is meant to improve data links between Hong Kong and those economies and to open more regional trade-finance business.

The authority also reported progress on its CargoX pilot. It said the Commercial Data Interchange had been linked to a digital-trade platform set up by the Shanghai Municipal Data Bureau. Five pilot banks were the first to obtain and use customs trade data from the Yangtze River Delta, to check that trades are genuine and to carry out due diligence. Hong Kong firms in onshore and offshore trade can then get loans more quickly, it said. The pilot has so far led to 10 approved trade-finance facilities totalling HK$180 million.

A CargoX solution day drew more than 300 people from banks, logistics and trade-data providers, government bodies and Commercial Data Interchange partners, the authority said. It said it would keep using CargoX to strengthen data links with the mainland, ASEAN and other corridors, with the aim of making cross-border trades more transparent and supporting smaller firms in the region.

zh.headline: 金管局與數位貿易聯盟簽備忘錄 接通貿易數據
zh.dek: 金管局說，商業數據通與上海數字貿易平台的試點已促成10宗貿易融資批核，貸款額達1.8億元。
body: 金管局星期一表示，已與數位貿易聯盟簽署諒解備忘錄，推動貨運物流和貿易數據互聯，以及貿易融資數字化。
金管局說，聯盟由多間貿易單一窗口營運商和電子商貿服務供應商組成，會員涵蓋包括東盟成員國在內的15個經濟體。備忘錄旨在提升香港與這些經濟體的數據互通，並增加區內貿易融資機會。
金管局又交代CargoX先導計劃的進展，稱「商業數據通」已連結上海市數據局建立的數字貿易平台。首批5間試點銀行可取得並運用長三角的貿易報關數據，用以核實貿易真實性和進行盡職審查，讓從事在岸及離岸貿易的香港企業更快取得貸款。試點至今已促成10宗貿易融資批核，貸款額達1.8億港元。
金管局說，CargoX方案日吸引逾300名來自銀行、貨運物流與貿易數據提供方、政府機關及「商業數據通」夥伴的人士。當局會繼續透過CargoX加強與內地、東盟等走廊的貿易數據聯繫，以提高跨境交易透明度，並支持區內中小企。
